newsitem.title: USA: UNR Industries votes extraordinary div.
newsitem.headline: UNR Industries votes extraordinary div.

text.p: UNR Industries Inc said Thursday its board declared a $2 per common share extraordinary dividend, payable September 27, record September 17.

President Thomas Gildehaus said "The majority of this dividend represents a partial liquidation distribution of the proceeds of the sales of the company's Leavitt Tube and Commercial Products Divisions."

"In addition, the company expects to distribute the proceeds from the sales of its home products division and Real Time Solutions subsidiary and to pay a dividend of our current year's earnings later this year," Gildehaus said in a statement.
"The company is continuing to work with J.P. Morgan Securities Inc, its financial advisor, in exploring the sale of its Real Time Solutions subsidiary," he added.
